intro.text: A lighthouse on Roshar's east coast. Its keeper, Puuli, calls it Defiance, but the locals just call it the lighthouse.

description.text: It stands on cliffs above the Ocean of Origins, at the end of a long, winding road. Over a hundred years old, it has been owned by Puuli's family for three generations or more.

The two-storey building is low and sturdy, its solid stonework made to withstand highstorms at full strength as they come ashore, with a coat of crem keeping out leaks. Puuli keeps his wagon on the ground floor; on the upper floor the fire burns, and mirrors cast its light out through an opening at night.
